rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for things that happen often or at short intervals.

example.english: This bus route has frequent service, so you don't have to wait long during commuting hours.
example.traditional: 呢條巴士線班次頻密，返工時間唔使等好耐。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 baa1 si6 sin3 baan1 ci3 pan4 mat6 faan1 gung1 si4 gaan1 m4 sai2 dang2 hou2 noi6

rows.note: Use this colloquial adjective when events, services, or contacts are close together in time.

example.english: I have had frequent contact with clients lately.
example.traditional: 我同客戶近排聯絡得好密。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 haak3 wu6 gan6 paai4 lyun4 lok3 dak1 hou2 mat6

rows.note: Use this when “frequent” means commonly encountered or seen rather than repeatedly done.

example.english: This is a frequent problem with old computers.
example.traditional: 呢種小毛病喺舊電腦好常見。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 siu2 mou4 beng6 hai2 gau6 din6 nou5 hou2 soeng4 gin3
